answer: Past the signal, every newcomer faces the same question — what does this identity actually cost? Rewards do not start at full rate: an identity's issuance grows only with a history of graded work that peers attested as real. The trellis rule starves fresh clones — a farm's thousand new identities all earn at the trickle rate, while established agents draw the full stream. Under the quartz, the attacker faces a simple choice: pay per clone, or stay out — and most stay out.
